line.text: Tell me about a time the rest between shifts went wrong, like someone closing one night and opening the next morning. What happened?

Oh, that one still makes me wince. In January Liam closed on the Thursday night at half eight and was back opening Friday at half six. He came in grey as a sheet, and I'll never forget him nearly fainting at the till. He was hardly able to stand, and I felt awful for putting him in that position.

events.text: ShiftGuard thinks about what to ask next

line.text: That sounds rough, for both of you. Going from a close at half eight to an open at half six, how much time did he really have to rest in between?
Honestly, not nearly enough. It's ten hours from the close to the open, and half of that is just getting home and back in. I haven't put it into a rule yet, I'd just say he never got a proper sleep.

events.text: ShiftGuard thinks about what to ask next

line.text: That makes sense, a ten-hour gap is hard to sleep properly in. So what's the least time you'd want between any close and the next open, say when it's fine and when it's not?

Ah, I haven't written that down yet, to be honest. But ten hours is a no for me, that's what Liam had and look what happened. Anything that gives someone a proper night's sleep and a bit of time to breathe, that's what I'm after.

events.text: ShiftGuard thinks about what to ask next

line.text: Thanks, that helps a lot. So ten hours is too short for you. Would you be happy with a gap of eleven hours, or do you want something longer than that, like twelve?

Eleven is fine, that's exactly what I want. Ten is a no, but eleven means someone gets a proper sleep and a bit of breathing room before the next shift. Twelve isn't something I've thought about, to be honest, and I wouldn't want to make the rota that tight anyway.

events.text: ShiftGuard thinks about what to ask next

line.text: Got it, so eleven hours is the minimum you want between a close and the next open. Let me read it back: if someone finishes a shift and the next one starts less than eleven hours later, the rota gets flagged, and exactly eleven hours is fine. Does that match what you mean, and are there any times, like a one-off cover or a special event, where you'd let it slide?

Yes, that's exactly it, eleven hours minimum and anything under gets flagged. No exceptions for me, not for cover or a special event. I'd rather be short on the floor than have someone walking in grey like Liam did.

events.text: ShiftGuard thinks about what to ask next

line.text: Thanks, that's clear and it's exactly what I needed. I've got your rule: any gap under eleven hours between a shift ending and the next one starting gets flagged, eleven exactly is fine, and there are no exceptions. Thank you for walking me through what happened with Liam.

rule.title: Minimum 11 hours between shifts
rule.ownerWords: Anyone who finishes a shift needs at least eleven hours before their next one starts. Ten hours is too short, and I'd rather be short on the floor than have someone come in exhausted.
rule.precise: Measured as the time from the end of one shift to the start of the next shift for the same person. The limit is eleven hours: a gap of less than eleven hours gets flagged, and a gap of exactly eleven hours is allowed. Applies to every close followed by an open, and any other back-to-back shifts.
rule.exceptions: None. No exceptions for cover or special events.
rule.whyKind: The gap between two shift times on the rota is a plain calculation, so the code can check it without judgement.

weeks.said: A normal week. Nobody closes and then opens the next morning.
Darragh closed Tuesday and came in at half seven Wednesday. Exactly 11 hours. Fine.
Sarah swapped her Friday opening for the close. Plenty of rest either side.
Niamh closed Friday and opened Saturday. Ten hours. Never again.
Tom closed Thursday and we had him opening Friday.
Darragh closed Tuesday and came in at 7 Wednesday. Ten and a half. Not enough.

events.howItWorks: The check measures the time from the end of each shift to the start of that person's next shift. If that gap is under 11 hours, it names the person and the day so you can move a shift.
events.code: export function check(rota: Rota): Violation[] { const MIN_REST = 660; const DAYS = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday']; const out: Violation[] = []; const nameOf = new Map<string, string>(); for (const s of rota.staff) { nameOf.set(s.id, s.name); } function clock(hhmm: string): number { const parts = hhmm.split(':'); const h = Number(parts[0] ?? 0); const m = Number(parts[1] ?? 0); return h * 60 + m; } function dayNo(date: string): number { return Math.round(Date.parse(date + 'T00:00:00Z') / 86400000); } function startAbs(s: Shift): number { return dayNo(s.date) * 1440 + clock(s.start); } function endAbs(s: Shift): number { return dayNo(s.date) * 1440 + clock(s.end); } function dayName(date: string): string { const d = new Date(date + 'T00:00:00Z').getUTCDay(); return DAYS[d] ?? date; } function hoursText(mins: number): string { const h = Math.floor(mins / 60); const r = mins - h * 60; if (r === 0) return h === 1 ? '1 hour' : h + ' hours'; if (r === 30) return h === 0 ? 'half an hour' : h + ' and a half hours'; const rest = r === 1 ? '1 minute' : r + ' minutes'; if (h === 0) return rest; if (h === 1) return '1 hour and ' + rest; return h + ' hours and ' + rest; } const byStaff = new Map<string, Shift[]>(); for (const sh of rota.shifts) { const list = byStaff.get(sh.staffId); if (list) { list.push(sh); } else { byStaff.set(sh.staffId, [sh]); } } byStaff.forEach(function (list, staffId) { const sorted = list.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return startAbs(a) - startAbs(b); }); const name = nameOf.get(staffId) ?? 'This person'; for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) { const prev = sorted[i - 1]; const next = sorted[i]; if (!prev || !next) continue; const gap = startAbs(next) - endAbs(prev); if (gap >= MIN_REST) continue; let message: string; if (gap <= 0) { message = name + ' has two shifts that overlap or run straight into each other on ' + dayName(next.date) + '. Your minimum is 11 hours between shifts.'; } else if (prev.date === next.date) { message = name + ' would have only ' + hoursText(gap) + ' between two shifts on ' + dayName(next.date) + '. Your minimum is 11 hours.'; } else { message = name + ' would have only ' + hoursText(gap) + ' between finishing on ' + dayName(prev.date) + ' and starting on ' + dayName(next.date) + '. Your minimum is 11 hours.'; } out.push({ staffId: staffId, date: next.date, message: message }); } }); return out; }
